problems: At 320 the hero column is 21px wider than the viewport (nowrap install code in a 1fr track), clipping the lede text and the Copy button; the same pattern makes the hero terminal a non-focusable horizontal scroller at 390 (axe serious).

Fragile/a11y gaps: margin notes positioned with hard-coded pixel offsets, no skip link, 23px-tall nav links, copy feedback not announced and reports 'Copied' even when execCommand fails.

reason: A is the page I would rather maintain: its sample report is operable in the first screen, handles every edge input I tried with a written message, works without JS from pre-rendered markup, and has no overflow at 320 or 390. B is lighter and well written but overflows at 320, needs sideways scrolling in its hero output on phones, and positions its annotations with magic numbers. A fix to B's 320/390 hero layout plus a focusable or wrapping terminal would narrow the gap, but not close it.
